nodes.label: RelayKit
nodes.rationale: 将协议数据建模和转换从宿主网关中拆出，同时将 HTTP、渠道选择、鉴权和计费留给宿主。

nodes.label: TokenKit
nodes.rationale: 只负责 token 计数或估算，不负责请求解析、图片下载或计费，以保持独立可复用。

nodes.label: Frontend Billing Expression Specification
nodes.rationale: The frontend shares expression semantics while preserving entry-specific presentation strategies; backend billing expressions remain the actual charging authority.

nodes.rationale: The constant package is intentionally restricted to reusable constants and standard-library dependencies to avoid coupling, business logic, and testing difficulties.
